Hey Friends, 
We now support Oculus Rift w/ Oculus touch controllers, in addition to supporting HTC Vive.  So now if you have a Rift, or a Vive, you can play.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Available
notes.content:
Hello!

We've published an update to BJB which includes:

* Use the side grip button on the controller to reset the Camera position to front and center.
* Less freezing occurring (more stable game)
* Dealer looks around a bit more (less fixated on player)
* Insurance now works as intended, Dealer deducts 50% of bet for insurance.
* Dealer now waits for player input on insurance offer
* Main menu screen has been repositioned to center.
* Dealer gives verbal accolades (Hey big spender!) only when a player spends over $500 on a hand.
* Credits and help menus working with swipe navigation to scroll up/down.
* Other code fixes for stability, proper math mechanics as well as minor art improvements.


My apologies you had to wait this long for these fixes. It's been a difficult past few months but we finally got this under wraps.  Please report any new bugs you find.  

Our next move is to make this available for Oculus users.

notes.title: General notice from the Developers
notes.content:
Thanks for being a part of the Blackjack Bailey VR game community.

My name is Mike Amerson and I'm the game's designer and Artist/animator on the project.

This game was designed to be a casual casino gaming experience and we hope you enjoy it.
You can play comfortably seated in VR, just like you were at a real casino blackjack table.
There is nothing to buy inside the game. It won't try to upsell you to buy chips, and there are no ads - Just gameplay.
If you run out of money you start over with a fresh bankroll.  You can practice your Blackjack strategy until you've perfected it.

Some things to note: 
Although the game is fully playable, it is still evolving, and we will continue to improve on it, and making the experience better over time.

I should have labeled it as an "early release" but that was my mistake and i apologize for that. Once i realized my mistake i tried to mark it as an early release but I had no way to go back. So just know that we are still working on it.

If you have any suggestions for it or run into any bugs feel free to post them up or contact me directly.  
I take player feedback seriously and we will continue to update and improve the game through your help, in combination with our own plans to make it better.

Thank you for the support.
